_about: Place strings decided by hand, each with its reason. `places` is merged over what the gazetteer answers by tools/build-tree-page.py; `refused` lists strings that are deliberately NOT placed (a country, a state, an island, or several places), with the reason. A string in neither, and not placed by the gazetteer, is listed in tree.report.json under places.unplaced. Nothing here is a guess: a point is the Record Atlas's own for the named place.

Nudgee, Brisbane, Queensland.name: Nudgee
Nudgee, Brisbane, Queensland.how: the string names Nudgee, a suburb of Brisbane. The gazetteer has no Nudgee and falls back to Brisbane (data/era-ground.tsv uses the Brisbane point for the region), which would draw it in the wrong place; the Record Atlas holds Nudgee at its own point

Lismore NSW.name: Lismore
Lismore NSW.how: the string names Lismore, New South Wales (NSW is the abbreviation); the gazetteer's answer is that town but is marked approx only because of the abbreviation. Point: the Record Atlas place Lismore

Lismore, Lismore City, New South Wales,.name: Lismore
Lismore, Lismore City, New South Wales,.how: the same town as the row «Lismore NSW», written in full (Lismore City is its council area); the gazetteer does not hold the long form. Point: the Record Atlas place Lismore

Murwillumbah NSW.name: Murwillumbah
Murwillumbah NSW.how: the string names Murwillumbah, New South Wales; the gazetteer's answer is that town but is marked approx only because of the abbreviation. Point: the Record Atlas place Murwillumbah NSW

refused.Italy: a country, not a place: a dot would be an invented town
refused.America: a country (the United States) or a continent, not a place
refused.Sicily: the whole island, not a town; the gazetteer's point is the centre of the island
refused.Queensland: a state, not a town; the gazetteer's point is the centre of the state
refused.Queensland, Australia: a state, not a town; the gazetteer's point is the centre of the state
refused.Township of Washington, New Jersey: several townships of this name in New Jersey (Bergen, Burlington, Gloucester, Hunterdon, Mercer, Morris, Warren...) and the string gives no county; the gazetteer picked Bergen County, which nothing here supports
